title: gap-to-feature logs PENDING verification at pick time — skipping re-compose every time it selects a gap it cannot act on
description: gap-to-feature logs PENDING verification at pick time — skipping re-compose every time it selects a gap it cannot act on, but never counts it. Measured: 432 picks of route-edit-56849210 in 48h and 200 picks of recommit-route-edit-9077062c-typecheck_dangling_reference-narrowed in 24h, none ever composed. A gap picked N times and never composed is a livelock, and the picker is the only component positioned to notice. It should count consecutive no-op picks per gap, emit that count, and file a livelock gap past a threshold instead of re-skipping silently forever.
